_comment: Curated list of JW-organizational terms that actually appear in this app's content (grepped from src/i18n/en.json and docs/src/en/**), for grounding-agent.md to look up official per-language renderings on jw.org. Not every translated string touches these terms - most i18n keys are generic UI words (Cancel, Settings, Download) that never need terminology grounding. `sourceUrls` are intentionally empty here: the grounding agent finds and cites its own jw.org sources per language rather than being handed unverified links.

terms.context: a traveling minister who oversees a circuit of congregations
a local group of Jehovah's Witnesses
the elder who chairs congregation meetings
the annual commemoration of Christ's death
one of the two weekly congregation meetings
a Bible study article discussed at meetings; abbreviated WT in the app
the magazine, Public and Study editions
a JW magazine title - proper noun, includes the exclamation mark
the official JW mobile app - proper noun, do not translate the app name itself
the official website - referred to in-app as "the official website of jw.org"
the JW songbook used at meetings
a larger JW gathering (circuit assembly / regional convention)
a larger JW gathering, smaller than a convention
the Our Christian Life and Ministry workbook
